title: adenophora morrisonensis subsp. uehatae
intro: Adenophora morrisonensis subsp. uehatae, commonly known as Uehara's adenophora, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family that is native to Taiwan. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to lower fever, reduce inflammation, and alleviate pain, while also exhibiting antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Adenophora morrisonensis subsp. uehatae include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
